mapper.insert: insert into bbs_collect (post_id, user_id, create_time) values (#{postId}, #{userId}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from bbs_collect where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select p.post_id, p.category_id, p.user_id, p.title, cast(p.content as char) as content, p.summary, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.collect_count, p.is_top, p.is_essence, p.is_anonymous, p.is_admin_push, p.status, p.del_flag, p.last_reply_time, p.last_reply_user, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, c.category_name, case when p.is_anonymous = '1' then '匿名用户' else u.nick_name end as nick_name, case when p.is_anonymous = '1' then '' else u.avatar end as avatar from bbs_post p left join bbs_category c on p.category_id = c.category_id left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id inner join bbs_collect col on p.post_id = col.post_id where col.user_id = #{userId} and p.del_flag = '0' order by col.create_time desc
